# Phase 1 build documents

Working documents for building Phase 1. DESIGN.md stays the specification; these record how the work was split.

- `plan.md` — packages, waves, milestones, file ownership, the balance stage, rulings and risks.
- `contracts.md` — the cross-section contract every package builds against (slice shapes, signatures, actions, pipeline part map, tuning keys, hooks, streams). Where it and `plan.md` differ, `contracts.md` wins.
- `rulings-a.md`, `rulings-b.md` — rulings on every open issue the planning readers raised, area by area. The `docs-rulings` package writes them into DESIGN and BALANCE.
- `common.md` — the rules each package agent follows.
